panel.title: Bill of quantities
panel.description: Measured contract quantities, physical progress, and progress bills. Progress is not Actual cost.
panel.emptyBody: Create a draft BOQ when you are ready to measure and bill by quantity. You can activate it once items are in place.
panel.simpleModeHint: Simple flow: Project → BOQ → Update progress → Create progress bill.

recon.title: Contract ↔ BOQ
recon.unavailable: Contract reconciliation needs Changes permission or a primary contract.

nodes.title: Chapters and items
nodes.empty: No lines yet. Add a chapter or item to the draft.

forms.title: Title (optional)
forms.activateHint: After activation, original quantities and prices are locked. Further changes go through approved change orders.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Record measured quantities for a period. Approval unlocks a progress bill - this never creates Actual cost.
progress.simpleApproveHint: Simple mode: approved quantity will equal measured quantity.
progress.taxAmount: VAT / tax amount (optional - blank means intentional zero tax)

allocate.title: Allocate approved change
allocate.description: Map an approved change order onto the active BOQ. Pending changes never update quantities.
allocate.noChangeOrders: No approved change orders on this project.

permissions.amountsHidden: Unit prices and amounts are hidden for your role. You can still update progress quantities.

errors.generic: Could not complete that BOQ action. Check the values and try again.
errors.duplicateBilling: This progress period is already billed - duplicate progress billing is blocked.
errors.billingRequiresApproved: Only an approved, unbilled progress period can create a bill.
errors.overMeasurement: Quantity exceeds the current BOQ quantity.
errors.negativePeriod: Negative period quantities require an explicit correction workflow.
errors.draftOnly: Only a draft BOQ can be edited.
errors.zeroPeriod: Period value is zero - nothing to bill.
errors.changeOrderInvalid: Change order was not found or does not belong to this project.

import.title: Import from Excel / CSV
import.hint: Import items into a draft BOQ. No silent partial import - invalid rows are reported.
import.draftOnlyHint: Import always targets a draft BOQ. If this project only has an active BOQ, import creates or uses a separate draft version.

kpis.title: Progress vs contract
kpis.alreadyBilledHint: This period is already linked to a bill - the same quantities cannot be billed again.

allocations.title: Change allocation history
allocations.empty: No approved changes allocated to the BOQ yet.

mappings.title: Related mappings
mappings.description: Link this item to work package, cost category, and budget line. Does not change BOQ amounts.

subcontractor.title: Subcontractor schedule
subcontractor.description: Cost rates for vendor engagements mapped to client BOQ items. Never mixed into client revenue.
subcontractor.activateHint: After activation the schedule is immutable. Create valuations against the active schedule.
subcontractor.periodQtyHint: Enter CURRENT-PERIOD quantity per line. Default is 0 - not the full agreed quantity.
subcontractor.flowHint: Draft → add lines → activate → valuation (period qty) → approve → create draft vendor bill. Posting stays in AP.
subcontractor.apManualNote: After approval, create a draft vendor bill here. It is not Actual and does not consume a PO. Posting stays in AP.
subcontractor.valuationCreated: Valuation draft saved. After approval you can create a draft vendor bill - it is not posted.
subcontractor.draftApCreated: Draft vendor bill created. It is not Actual until posted in AP.
subcontractor.draftApNeedsPermission: Creating a draft vendor bill needs AP manage permission.
subcontractor.costSideOnly: Cost side only - not client BOQ revenue.
subcontractor.agreementRetention: Draft bills will use {percent}% retention unless you override it.

comparison.title: BOQ vs financials
comparison.progressNotActual: Physical progress is not Actual. Actual and Forecast come from the financials engine only.

measure.title: Field measurement
measure.description: Record measured quantities on site. Unit prices, profit, and commercial totals stay in the office.
measure.emptyBody: An active bill of quantities with items is needed before field measurement.
measure.inactiveHint: Progress can be recorded once the BOQ is active.
measure.selectItem: Select an item to enter a measured quantity.
measure.officeApproveHint: Approval stays on the office BOQ tab.
measure.noSubmitPermission: You can view quantities. Submitting measurements needs progress permission.
